title: Counter configuration after counting
statement: For every finite Boolean list $x$ and every natural number $i\le |x|$, there exists a time $t$ such that $t+2$ times the number of true bits in the binary representation of $i$ is at most $4i$, and after $t$ steps from the machine's initial configuration on $x$, the machine is in state $0$, its input head is at position $i+1$, its work-tape head is at position $0$, its tape contains the binary representation of $i$, and its output is empty.
